invented_facts: Aurora 14 will reduce the firm's cloud workstation bill or replace subscription fees.
Approving pilot units now would allow deployment before the Q1 budget window closes; the spec lists Q4 availability.
Cloud workstation fees apply to every seat or are charged per user.
Client drawings are locked behind a firewall.
Aurora 14 will let engineers annotate drawings, run simulations, and access project files offline; the spec does not establish those application capabilities.
Project data never leaves the device unless a user chooses to sync it, and the firm's security posture will improve.
A pilot program is available and can fit the Q1 approval window.
The budget cycle ends this quarter, and waiting will lock in current cloud costs for another year.
notes: All three emails have subjects and broadly follow the requested sequence, but emails 1 and 2 exceed 120 words. Email 3 offers two meeting-response actions and also asks the reader to say if they prefer to wait, rather than presenting exactly one clear CTA.
